description: Three callers about the same garage fire at 18107 Fairhope Oak Street, Houston (hero 214905148, two floors, bedrooms upstairs). A neighbour across the street (flames under the garage door, someone at an upstairs window right above the garage), a passer-by (buckled garage door, popping, maybe propane, a face at the upstairs front left window) and the father (his daughter in the bedroom over the kitchen, next to the bonus room). Relations resolve the daughter's room; front/left and the window above the garage stay at floor level. Expected: data/fixtures/calls/expected/s7_fairhope_oak.json.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address of your emergency?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: There's a house on fire across from me, 18107 Fairhope Oak Street. The garage is on fire.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: 18107 Fairhope Oak Street, the garage. What do you see?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Flames coming out from under the garage door, and black smoke going up over the roof.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Is anybody inside the house?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I... I think so. I saw somebody in a window upstairs, on the garage side.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Upstairs, above the garage?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yeah, like right above it. There was a light on and somebody moved, then the curtain closed.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Could you tell if it was an adult or a child?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, I couldn't tell. Sorry. It was real quick.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: That's okay. Is the fire spreading?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: It's getting into the roof now, over the garage. The cars in the driveway are okay so far.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I'm walking my dog on Fairhope Oak, there's a garage on fire, I don't know the number, sorry.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: We have a report at 18107 Fairhope Oak Street. Two-story house?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yeah, two stories, brick, big two-car garage. That's gotta be it.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The garage door's all buckled, there's fire coming out the bottom and out the side.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hold on. There's somebody upstairs, front left window, the blinds are up, I saw a face for a second.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Upstairs, front left window. Did you see anyone else?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, just the one. And there's popping in the garage, like cans going off.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I don't know, maybe propane, like for a grill? It keeps popping.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Stay well back from the garage, sir.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yeah, I'm across the street now, me and the dog.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My house is on fire, 18107 Fairhope Oak, my daughter's inside!

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Sir, where is your daughter?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: She's upstairs, in her bedroom. The bedroom over the kitchen.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Over the kitchen. Is that at the back of the house?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Uh, the back, yeah, I mean... it's over the kitchen. She's in the bedroom over the kitchen.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Where are you right now?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I'm outside, I came out the front door. It started in the garage, I heard a bang and then all this smoke.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Her room's the one at the end of the hall when you come up the stairs, no, wait, that's the bonus room. Hers is next to the bonus room.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Is anyone else in the house?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, just her. My wife's at work. She's eleven, her name's Brianna.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Is the door from the garage into the house open?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I think I left it open when I ran out. I don't know, I don't know.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Okay, firefighters are almost there, stay outside.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Tell them she's over the kitchen. Please.
